name: ItemBlueprint - Default (seed v1)
description: An item blueprint: the template every copy of an item is made from. Its name and lore in game, material, grade, price range, default enchantments, tags and origin.

sections.description: What the item is called, for admins and in game, and what it is made of.

fields.label: Admin name
fields.description: Name used in the web app and admin commands; players see the display name.

fields.label: Admin description
fields.description: Notes for admins. Not shown in game.

fields.label: Display name
fields.description: The item's name in game.

fields.label: Lore
fields.description: Text shown under the name on the item in game.

fields.label: Material
fields.description: The Minecraft material the item is made of; also its icon in menus.

sections.description: Where the item sits in the catalog and how rare it is.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Catalog group the item belongs to.

fields.label: Grade
fields.description: Rarity tier. It sets the drop chance and caps the enchantment levels the item can hold.

fields.label: Stars
fields.description: Stars shown in the item's lore for its grade.

sections.description: How many come at once and what one item is worth.

fields.label: Default quantity
fields.description: How many are handed out at once, e.g. by a loot box roll, unless that says otherwise.

fields.label: Max stack size
fields.description: Most items that fit in one inventory slot (1-64).

fields.label: Lowest base price
fields.description: Bottom of the item's price range for trading.

fields.label: Highest base price
fields.description: Top of the item's price range for trading.

sections.description: Enchantments every new copy of the item gets. Change them with Edit (Default enchantments step).

fields.label: Enchantment
fields.description: The enchantment.

fields.label: Level
fields.description: Level new copies get.

fields.label: Max level
fields.description: Highest level the enchantment allows.

fields.label: Custom
fields.description: A Knights and Kings enchantment rather than a vanilla one.

sections.description: Free labels used to search and filter items. Change them with Edit.

fields.label: Tag
fields.description: The tag.

sections.description: Where the item comes from, oldest first: entry 0 is where it is produced, later entries are where it was changed. Change them with Edit.

fields.label: Place
fields.description: Town, district or structure.

fields.label: Kind of place
fields.description: Whether the place is a town, district or structure.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: 0 = where the item is produced; higher = later.

notes: Material: the read DTO calls it "iconMaterialRef" (model navigation "IconMaterial"), hence metadataCheck "warn".
The collections have no buttons: their items (join rows) have no id, so View/Edit would open ".../undefined".
